what: Which card wins when a playoff standout and a Super Season land on the same team, for the 27 players where both exist.
rule: THE GOLD LINE DECIDES. Keep the Super Season only when it clears SUPER_SEASON_MIN_SALARY (900, src/cards/badges.js) — the same line that decides whether a card prints the gold SUPER SEASON pill or the plain BEST SEASON one. Below it the card is a best season the set does not gild, and a playoff run is the more distinctive card. Named overrides beat the rule.
whyNotSalaryAlone: Straight salary favoured the Super Season on 21 of 27, including cards at 360 and 400 that would displace a playoff run while printing no gold. The gold line is a threshold the set already applies to exactly this question.

keepSuperSeason.name: Shaquille O'Neal
keepSuperSeason.note: Settled by PORTING his existing 25-26 legend card and repricing it on play value. EPM begins in 2002, so his 2000 season has no Speed+Power budget to generate and the composite priced it at replacement (Speed+Power 14). The hand-made card already has a budget, and play value reads the FINISHED CARD rather than EPM -- 710 under the old model, 1190 under this one, clear of the 900 gold line.

Tyrese Haliburton.why: Your call, against the rule — the Super Season clears the line at 1070. The 2025 Finals run is the card wanted. No Super Season for him.
